title: The Silent Lab
description: Graduate student Yoon Jaehee is found dead in a sealed chemistry lab at dawn. Four colleagues are under investigation.

answer.motive: Plagiarism dispute — Park Minsu discovered Yoon Jaehee was using his unpublished data without credit
answer.method: Swapped NaN3/NaCl container labels → Yoon added HCl to sodium azide instead of sodium chloride → hydrazoic acid gas produced → lethal concentration built up due to recirculate-mode ventilation

motive_options: Plagiarism dispute — Park Minsu discovered Yoon Jaehee was using his unpublished data without credit
Resource competition — Park Minsu feared Yoon would displace him from the postdoc position
Academic authority — Dr. Kim sought to prevent Yoon from publishing results that contradicted his own
Intellectual property — Prof. Cho sought to prevent Yoon from publishing findings that overlapped with his own research
Lab negligence — Lee Soyeon's improper chemical storage caused an accidental fatal exposure
method_options: Swapped NaN3/NaCl container labels → Yoon added HCl to sodium azide instead of sodium chloride → hydrazoic acid gas produced → lethal concentration built up due to recirculate-mode ventilation
Dissolved sodium azide directly into Yoon's water bottle → acute systemic azide poisoning
Sabotaged the fume hood fan motor → toxic vapors from Yoon's legitimate experiment accumulated in the sealed room
Added potassium cyanide to the HCl reagent bottle → hydrogen cyanide gas released during the acid addition step
